title: xDrip plus wont open on on Tic Watch Pro
body:
Hi I have a Tic Watch Pro with Wear OS version 2.6. It is a Tic Watch Pro 1577 model 12096. I have loaded xDrip Plus apk onto it via the sideload process using minimal ADB. I see the app on the watch I tap it, it opens with the agreement not to take medical decisions etc etc I click agree and then the app appears to crash. I click on the app icon again and the screen goes black and the watch goes back to the list of apps. That's as far as I've got I cant get into the app to set it up. Can anyone tell me what's going on?
Thanx
Kwisj
